title: std::istream_iterator<T,CharT,Traits,Distance>::operator++, operator++(int)
summary: Reads a value from the underlying stream (using its operator>>) and stores it into the iterator object. If the read fails (the underlying stream's fail() returns true), the iterator becomes the end-of-stream iterator.
html:
istream_iterator& operator++();
 (1)
istream_iterator operator++( int );
 (2)

Reads a value from the underlying stream (using its operator>>) and stores it into the iterator object. If the read fails (the underlying stream's fail() returns true), the iterator becomes the end-of-stream iterator.

The behavior is undefined if the iterator is end-of-stream iterator.

Parameters

(none)

Return value

1) *this
2) An istream_iterator that holds an unchanged value.

Exceptions

May throw implementation-defined exceptions.

Defect reports

The following behavior-changing defect reports were applied retroactively to previously published C++ standards.
